semantics.selection: largest observed output gap containing a recorded preemption; all episodes also reported
semantics.evidence_type: CPU analysis of existing host observations, not a GPU experiment or causal intervention
semantics.output_clock: raw relative host receipt + measurement_origin_perf_counter_s within the same run
semantics.job_completed: native completion report observed on host; absolute GPU completion unknown
semantics.schedule: native plan return, not GPU execution
semantics.allocation: all attempts from capacity-handoff; recovery-order allocation events are state changes only
semantics.normalization_scope: all LOAD/unknown-direction lifecycle and request recovery events; STORE/reorder/global flush traffic remains in raw evidence
semantics.missing_fields: null means unknown; physical block IDs and token counts are not invented logical ranges
semantics.causality: all cause attribution unknown; measured intervals may overlap and must not be summed
